env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# Go should reject relative paths in BOLERO_MODCACHE environment.

env BOLERO_MODCACHE="~/test"
! bolero install example.com/tools/cmd/hello@latest
stderr 'must be absolute path'

env BOLERO_MODCACHE="./test"
! bolero install example.com/tools/cmd/hello@latest
stderr 'must be absolute path'
